missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Игра' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Эта' points at a specific one, and 'интересная' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Игру' is the accusative direct object of 'выиграли'. 'Последнюю' agrees in the feminine accusative, marking the final match.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Игры' is in the genitive case marking whose rules they are. 'Этой' agrees in the genitive feminine, linking the noun to 'правила'.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Игре' is in the dative case after 'к', expressing preparation for the match. 'Новой' agrees in the dative feminine.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Игрой' is in the instrumental case after 'довольны', which governs the instrumental of the thing one is pleased with. 'Новой' agrees in the instrumental feminine.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об этой игре' uses the prepositional form after 'об' to express what is discussed. 'Этой' agrees in the prepositional feminine.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Игры' is the nominative plural subject of the predicate 'популярны'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, describing widely liked games.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Игры' is the accusative plural object of 'любят', identical to the nominative plural for this inanimate noun. 'Разные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Игр' is the genitive plural after 'много', with a fleeting vowel dropping to leave a bare consonant cluster. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive in a time phrase. 'Игры' is in the genitive case after 'во время', a fixed phrase meaning during. The construction sets the moment of the injury.
